notes.accuracy: Percent; final checkpoint is primary. Best is a separate diagnostic, not model selection.
notes.spread: Sample standard deviation across three MNIST seeds (ddof=1); CIFAR n=1, no SD.
notes.timing: Synchronized training/evaluation excludes data loading, logging and checkpoints. Wall logged: config start to final evaluation timestamp, before final checkpoint.
notes.speedups: Baseline-to-cycle time ratios for the full configured training budgets, not time to the same accuracy.
notes.threshold: First logged accuracy at or above threshold; no interpolation. Earlier unobserved crossings between evaluations are possible.
notes.curves: All original logged points are included; connecting segments are visual guides, not additional observations.
